title: Checking understanding
scenario: You are in a teacher role. Use English naturally in this checking understanding situation.

lines.text: Let's check if everyone understood the listening exercise.
I followed the main idea, but missed some details.
That is fine for now. What was the main topic?
The speakers were discussing a school event.
Correct. You should try to improve your note-taking skills.
If I practised more often, would my listening improve?
Definitely. Regular practice makes a big difference.
I will start practising every day from now on.
